_comment: St. Anton am Arlberg (Ski Arlberg) corrections. Main fix: reconnect the Zurs->Lech Madloch descent (OSM gap) so the Flexenbahn interconnection routes end-to-end; plus a few stray-endpoint snaps.
_comment2: False-elevation cluster at the Muggengrat junction (~47.164, 10.135). A DEM spike put n325116111 (144 Muggengrat - Taeli top) 62 m too high while the surrounding knoll sampled ~25-30 m too low, so every piste there drained INTO n325116082 instead of out of it, orphaning the two Muggengrat tops. Values are the corrected terrain samples from npm run check:elevation st-anton-arlberg; n325116019 (lift station on the same knoll) was 29 m low but under the 40 m audit threshold.
_comment3: n327317441<->n279609294 (~47.152, 10.222) is a flat saddle where skiers off either neighbouring lift top choose to descend east or west. The whole basin samples ~30 m low on the reference DEM, so the audit flagged the 61 m link as a reversal; the real answer is that it is two-way, not backwards. A bidirectional flat_traverse expresses that (setNodeElevation can only demote a flat traverse to a one-way piste, never promote one).

ignoreReversals.why: See _comment3: this is a two-way flat saddle, expressed via the bidirectional addConnectors entry above. The piste edge's own orientation is deliberately left alone, so the audit would otherwise flag it forever.
